title: Social content notice
slide_intent: Make content context visible before viewing, because audiences may need a quick indication of the material’s tone.
strategic_value: A green notice strip, 4moji and channel signature can identify Channel 4 content within a social platform’s own interface.
demonstration: A cropped social post shows the channel4 account header, a green avatar, a white 4 over programme footage and a green text strip including Adult humour with a devil-face icon.
practical_value: Compare the platform account identity with the brand’s own content notice and in-frame logo.

content_islands.name: Platform header
content_islands.spec: Retain the channel4 name, verification mark and green avatar above the post.

content_islands.name: Content notice
content_islands.spec: Place the black notice and devil icon on the green strip above the programme subject.

content_islands.name: Programme image
content_islands.spec: Keep the white 4 at the upper left of the footage and the presenter’s face as the main image.

reference_purposes.Expression: A cropped social post shows the channel4 account header, a green avatar, a white 4 over programme footage and a green text strip including Adult humour with a devil-face icon.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in a social post with a content notice.
